title: Navimower 0.4.7-beta4

## Bounded get-iot-file research action

This prerelease adds the maintainer-only `navimower.probe_iot_file` action for controlled investigation of Navimow's fixed read-only:

`/mowerbot/vehicle/common/get-iot-file`

The action does not accept an arbitrary endpoint or request payload.

- The default probe checks file types `0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5`.
- A run may request at most 8 unique integer types in the bounded `0..15` range.
- Each type tries the observed `vehicle_sn` request shape first and the legacy/alternate `sn` shape only if needed.
- The known `type=2` terrain resource remains production-owned by the existing TerrainOverlayManager; this probe does not alter terrain capability decisions or cache behavior.
- Unknown types are discovery-only. A successful response does not automatically enable a feature or create a new capability.

Probe JSON is written under `/config/navimower_diagnostics/probes/` with timestamped and latest files.

## Optional artifact inspection

`download_artifacts` is off by default.

When enabled, a returned signed resource may be downloaded for private analysis under a hard 16 MiB per-file limit. The probe records:

- content type, byte size, SHA-256 and leading magic bytes;
- ZIP validity and bounded archive-entry names/sizes;
- basic JSON/text structure when applicable.

If artifacts are downloaded, the action also creates a ZIP bundle containing the probe JSON and local artifact files.

Signed vendor download URLs are held only in memory for the fetch and are never persisted in probe JSON, notifications or bundles.

## Privacy / release boundary

This is a prerelease development surface, not a public support action.

- Home Assistant Download diagnostics remains cached-only and sanitized.
- The general arbitrary private-API probe remains retired.
- Passive MQTT discovery and exact MQTT-payload retention remain retired.
- `navimower.export_raw_data` remains available on this prerelease line.
- Both `probe_iot_file` and raw export must be removed again before stable promotion.

## Unchanged runtime behavior

No mower state, Schedule, Gate, Map Card, ZoneLedger, VendorTrailStore, MQTT ordering, keepalive or normal terrain polling behavior changes in this beta.
